premise: Duckling sees the moon floating in the pond and tries to scoop it up — it wobbles away every time; Owl wakes and tells him to look up, Firefly adds a second little light to the water, and Duckling falls asleep with the moon watching over him.
inspiration: The monkeys who tried to catch the moon in the well (Indian and Chinese folk), turned: nobody falls in, and the moon is loveliest left where it is — up in the sky and down in the pond at once.
lesson: Some lovely things are for looking at, not keeping.

en-US.title: Duckling Catches the Moon
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] The sun was going down. Up on a branch, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Owl had slept all day, and he was {owl:live doze hold} still fast asleep. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to pond} Duckling waddled over for one last paddle. {canvas:night 0.8} Then up came the moon. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] "A moon IN the pond! I'll catch it!" {duckling:go to pond another by swim} Off he paddled. {duckling:live scoop} He scooped with his beak… {sfx:splash} splish! The moon wobbled to pieces. {duckling:face sad} Then, little by little, it came back. He tried again… {sfx:splash} {duckling:spray} SPLASH! Gone again. {owl:live doze resume} Owl opened one eye, then the other. {sfx:hoot} "Hoo? What's all the splashing?" {duckling:pulse} "I'm catching the moon!" {owl:face happy} [giggles] {owl:live talk} "Look up," said Owl. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:sparkle} There it was! Up in the sky AND down in the pond! {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to pond} Firefly came drifting down to look, and {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} glowed over the water like a little lantern. Now there were two lights in the pond, a big one and a little one. {duckling:face sleeping} Duckling yawned, and {duckling:live nap hold} tucked his head under his wing. [whispers] And the moon stayed right where it was… and watched him sleep.

es-ES.title: Patito quiere coger la luna
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.7} [softly] El sol se estaba poniendo. En una rama, {owl:enter} {owl:go to branches} Búho había dormido todo el día, y {owl:live doze hold} seguía dormido como un lirón. {duckling:enter} {duckling:go to pond} Patito llegó a la charca para el último chapuzón. {canvas:night 0.8} Entonces salió la luna. {duckling:face surprised} [gasps] —¡Hay una luna DENTRO de la charca! ¡Voy a cogerla! {duckling:go to pond another by swim} Y allá fue, nadando. {duckling:live scoop} Intentó pescarla con el pico… {sfx:splash} ¡chof! La luna se hizo mil pedacitos temblorosos. {duckling:face sad} Pero, poco a poco, volvió a juntarse. Otra vez… {sfx:splash} {duckling:spray} ¡CHOF! Nada. {owl:live doze resume} Búho abrió un ojo, y luego el otro. {sfx:hoot} —¿Uuu? ¿A qué viene tanto chapoteo? {duckling:pulse} —¡Estoy cogiendo la luna! {owl:face happy} [giggles] {owl:live talk} —Mira hacia arriba —dijo Búho. {duckling:face happy} {duckling:sparkle} ¡Allí estaba! ¡Arriba en el cielo Y abajo en la charca! {firefly:enter} {firefly:go to pond} Luciérnaga bajó a curiosear y {firefly:glow 1 3s #FFE27A} brilló sobre el agua como un farolillo. Ahora había dos luces en la charca: una grande y otra chiquitita. {duckling:face sleeping} Patito bostezó y {duckling:live nap hold} escondió la cabeza bajo el ala. [whispers] Y la luna se quedó donde estaba… mirándolo dormir.

splash.prompt: a duckling's beak dipping into a still pond, a small soft splash, realistic
